summary.value: Tooltip component that displays a small piece of information when hovering or focusing on an element.

example.value:
<Tooltip content='This is a tooltip'>
 <button>Hover me</button>
</Tooltip>

@example
<Tooltip content='This is a tooltip'>
 Hover me
</Tooltip>

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Tooltip must not be used as a substitute for alt text or title attributes
value.quote: Tooltip should never be used as a replacement for alt text or title .

value.rule: Tooltip is less suitable on touch devices since it normally relies on hover or focus, which touch does not support
value.quote: On touch devices, Tooltip is less suitable because it is normally triggered by hover or focus , which are not supported on these devices.

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.note: Use popover instead of tooltip when the explanation is longer than four words
value.quote: the explanation is longer than four words, use popover instead

value.note: Use popover instead of tooltip when the content contains links or other interactive elements
value.quote: the content contains links or other interactive elements, use popover instead

value.note: Use popover instead of tooltip when richer content such as longer text, images, or buttons is needed
value.quote: If richer content is needed - for example longer text, images, or buttons - use a popover instead.

value.note: The Tooltip `open` prop is deprecated for overriding open state; use Popover instead
value.quote: This should not be used on Tooltip. Use a Popover instead

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Tooltip provides brief supplementary information without distracting from the main content
value.quote: Tooltip provides brief supplementary information without distracting from the main content.

value.rule: Tooltip is not intended for information essential to completing a task
value.quote: Tooltip is not intended for information that is essential for completing a task.

value.rule: Important content should appear as body text or help text on the page, not in a tooltip
value.quote: Important content should instead appear as body text or help text on the page.

value.rule: Use tooltip when a symbol needs explanation, an interactive element's action needs clarifying, or keyboard shortcuts need to be shown
value.quote: Use tooltip when a symbol needs a brief explanation the action of an interactive element needs to be clarified keyboard shortcuts need to be shown

value.rule: Avoid using tooltip when the text is already visible on the page
value.quote: Avoid using tooltip when the text is already visible on the page

value.rule: Consider whether the tooltip should be placed above, below, or beside the element
value.quote: Consider whether the tooltip should be placed above, below, or beside the element.

value.rule: A tooltip should not contain more than one sentence or more than four words, to avoid obstructing other important elements on screen
value.quote: A tooltip should not contain more than one sentence or more than four words, to avoid obstructing other important elements on the screen.

value.rule: Tooltip should not repeat text that is already present on the page
value.quote: Tooltip should not repeat text that is already present on the page.

value.rule: Tooltip content should provide additional help or clarification that is not immediately obvious
value.quote: It should provide additional help or clarification that is not immediately obvious.
